cards.what_happened: A 36-year-old man who was being held by police in Matale died after he became ill. Officers took him to the Matale District General Hospital, and he was pronounced dead at around 12.45 a.m. The police said he had been arrested for allegedly having ICE drugs.
details: The source is a Newswire report. A 36-year-old man was arrested for allegedly having ICE narcotics. He died after suddenly becoming ill while held at the Matale Police Station early today (20).

The police said he was rushed to the Matale District General Hospital after he fell ill in the detention cell. He was pronounced dead at around 12.45 a.m. The man was identified as a resident of Dilenagama, Ampitiya, Kandy.

He was arrested last morning (19) in the Hithgolla area of Matale by the Matale Police Anti-Corruption Unit. He was accused of having 3,010 milligrams of ICE, and he reportedly became ill around 11.00 pm after being detained. The police said he was heavily addicted to drugs and had several drug cases pending at about 10 police stations, including Kandy and Grandpass; a Post mortem is scheduled for today and Matale Police are investigating the death.
key_facts: 36-year-old man arrested for allegedly possessing ICE narcotics died.
He fell ill at Matale Police Station and died early today (20).
He was rushed to Matale District General Hospital, pronounced dead at 12.45 a.m.
He was from Dilenagama, Ampitiya, Kandy.
Arrested last morning (19) in Hithgolla area of Matale for 3,010 milligrams of ICE.
He had several drug cases at about 10 police stations.
Post mortem scheduled today; Matale Police investigating death.
cards.whats_next: A Post mortem is set for today, and Matale Police are still looking into the death.
cards.blurb: A 36-year-old drug suspect died in police custody after falling ill, and police are investigating.
cards.spoken: Here is what we know about the story. A 36-year-old man was arrested in Matale. He was accused of having ICE drugs. He was held at the Matale Police Station. During the night, he became very ill. He was taken to the Matale District General Hospital. He was later pronounced dead around 12.45 a.m. The police say he had been arrested for allegedly having 3,010 milligrams of ICE. Officers from the Matale Police Anti-Corruption Unit made the arrest in the Hithgolla area. He had reportedly been addicted to drugs. He had other drug cases at about 10 police stations. A post mortem is set for today. The police are investigating.
